title: Block Out Level 26 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 26 is a bridge-and-boss board. Drain the upper chamber into the `18` throat first, lower the bridge second, and only then let the huge lower `21` boss start collapsing.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 26 is a bridge-and-boss board. Drain the upper chamber into the `18` throat first, lower the bridge second, and only then let the huge lower `21` boss start collapsing.
landmarks: Block Out Level 26 is a bridge-and-boss board.
Drain the upper chamber into the `18` throat first, lower the bridge second, and only then let the huge lower `21` boss start collapsing.
The board mixes Pink, Green, White and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The lower `21` panel is a second-phase target.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Feed the upper chamber into the central `18` throat and start lowering its count.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Keep shaving the side counters in the top room while the lower `21` panel stays untouched.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Use the white-and-black blockers in the top room to keep the bridge from refilling.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Once the `18` lane is much lower, open the passage into the lower chamber.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Start shrinking the `21` boss only after the bridge is no longer crowded.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Rotate the late purple and red pieces once the bottom room has actual space.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last upper leftovers after the lower boss has already fallen.

failurePoints: Trying to work the lower boss before the bridge has opened.
Letting the upper chamber refill the `18` throat after it has already started dropping.
